_comment: The GREEN subset of scripts/, and the gate `bun run typecheck:scripts` runs.
Measured 2026-09-19: 55 TypeScript files live under scripts/ and NO tsconfig covered any of
them, so the release and deploy pipeline shipped without a type gate. Switching the whole
directory on at once yields 299 errors (almost all noUncheckedIndexedAccess), and this
repository refuses a permanently red gate: a gate that is always red is a gate nobody reads.
So this file is a RATCHET. 27 files are green today. Clean one more, add it here, and it can
never regress. A new script belongs in this list from its first commit.
The remaining 28 are listed in CONTRIBUTING.md under 'Type gate ratchet'.
deploy-target.ts joined on 2026-09-20; the gate immediately found a defect on its ROLLBACK
path, where symlink(previous) ran with previous undefined, threw inside the catch block, and
masked the health-check failure that triggered it. Sixteen errors, fifteen of them mechanical.
